mapper.sql: m.member_id AS memberId, m.nickname, m.avatar, m.invite_code AS inviteCode, m.disabled_flag AS disabledFlag, m.create_time AS createTime, m.last_login_time AS lastLoginTime, COALESCE(hc.cnt, 0) AS helperCount, COALESCE(tc.cnt, 0) AS createdTaskCount, COALESCE(pc.participantCount, 0) AS participantCount, COALESCE(pc.completedCount, 0) AS completedCount, COALESCE(pc.onTimeCount, 0) AS onTimeCount

LEFT JOIN ( SELECT member_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM t_helper WHERE deleted_flag = 0 GROUP BY member_id ) hc ON hc.member_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT creator_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM t_task WHERE deleted_flag = 0 GROUP BY creator_id ) tc ON tc.creator_id = m.member_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT p.member_id AS memberId, COUNT(*) AS participantCount, SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 2 AND p.complete_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 2 AND p.complete_time IS NOT NULL AND p.complete_time <= t.deadline THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS onTimeCount FROM t_task_participant p INNER JOIN t_task t ON t.task_id = p.task_id AND t.deleted_flag = 0 WHERE p.deleted_flag = 0 GROUP BY p.member_id ) pc ON pc.memberId = m.member_id
mapper.select: SELECT h.helper_member_id AS helperMemberId, hm.nickname, hm.avatar, hm.invite_code AS inviteCode, h.remark, h.create_time AS createTime FROM t_helper h INNER JOIN t_wx_member hm ON hm.member_id = h.helper_member_id AND hm.deleted_flag = 0 WHERE h.deleted_flag = 0 AND h.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY h.helper_id DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT t.task_id AS taskId, t.title, t.creator_id AS creatorId, c.nickname AS creatorNickname, t.status AS status, t.deadline AS deadline, t.create_time AS createTime, 'participant' AS memberRole, p.status AS participantStatus, p.complete_time AS completeTime, CASE WHEN p.complete_time IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN p.complete_time <= t.deadline THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS onTimeFlag FROM t_task_participant p INNER JOIN t_task t ON t.task_id = p.task_id AND t.deleted_flag = 0 INNER JOIN t_wx_member c ON c.member_id = t.creator_id WHERE p.deleted_flag = 0 AND p.member_id = #{memberId} UNION ALL SELECT t.task_id, t.title, t.creator_id, c.nickname, t.status, t.deadline, t.create_time, 'creator', NULL, NULL, NULL FROM t_task t INNER JOIN t_wx_member c ON c.member_id = t.creator_id WHERE t.deleted_flag = 0 AND t.creator_id = #{memberId} ) x ORDER BY x.createTime DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(p.complete_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statDate, COUNT(*) AS completedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN p.complete_time <= t.deadline THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS onTimeCount FROM t_task_participant p INNER JOIN t_task t ON t.task_id = p.task_id AND t.deleted_flag = 0 WHERE p.deleted_flag = 0 AND p.member_id = #{memberId} AND p.status = 2 AND p.complete_time >= #{startTime} AND p.complete_time < #{endTime} GROUP BY DATE(p.complete_time) ORDER BY DATE(p.complete_time)
